why_ai: Each game is a novel creative bet, though generative tools cut production cost and flood stores.
why_clarity: Fun is taste, every game is one-off, and the verdict arrives at launch years later.
why_digital: Games are built in engines and sold through online stores worldwide.

why_ai: The obstacle is partnerships with data holders, not analysis AI could do.
why_clarity: Corpus coverage is measurable, but each data partnership is negotiated differently.
why_digital: Platform and publisher data aggregated and sold online.

why_ai: Signals exist and forecasting from them is a modelling task.
why_clarity: Sales forecasts are checkable, but only at launch long after the prediction.
why_digital: Wishlist and demo data modelled into forecasts online.

why_ai: Forecasting completion from recorded velocity is mechanical once work is logged.
why_clarity: Completion dates are exact, but they are confirmed months or years later.
why_digital: Task and velocity data in project tools.

why_ai: Requirements checking and build pipelines are highly automatable.
why_clarity: Hundreds of written requirements with pass or fail submissions.
why_digital: Builds, checklists and store submissions all digital.

why_ai: Telemetry, session analysis and reporting are mechanical instrumentation.
why_clarity: Drop-off points are measurable, but enjoyment is inferred from behaviour.
why_digital: Game telemetry from demos and playtests analysed in software.

why_ai: Discount depth and timing is the most mechanical decision in the sector.
why_clarity: Each sale's revenue effect is observed within weeks on the store.
why_digital: Store pricing and sales data handled entirely online.

why_ai: Modelling a studio's own signals against a benchmark is software work.
why_clarity: Forecasts are concrete numbers, but they are verified only after launch.
why_digital: Studio telemetry and store data turned into recommendations online.

why_ai: Generative tools make art and copy variants cheap, and conversion is testable.
why_clarity: Wishlist conversion is measurable fast, but capsule art and trailers are taste.
why_digital: Store pages, trailers and conversion data are all online.

why_ai: Studios hire specific artists and composers, but generative tools substitute much of the work.
why_clarity: Engagements are scoped in a paragraph and quality is a matter of taste.
why_digital: Remote freelance creative work delivered as files.

why_ai: Authentic developer voice matters, but cadence and asset production automate.
why_clarity: Marketing effort is open-ended and its effect shows only at launch.
why_digital: Social posts, devlogs and community work done online.
